what: FFA drop-on-death AFTER ARM at GV46: the pinned sample the GV47 scoring-weight change is measured against.
metric_retirement: The placement metric corr(placementScore, killRate) used by ffa_before_arm_gv45 is retired: placement does not reach Elo — the platform rates each policy by its mean episode score (results.scores), so the metric of record is now corr(score, killRate).
definition: Every completed 'Battle Royale (12)' episode in hosted league rounds 2067-2110 inclusive whose public replay re-simulates at GameVersion 46 under tools/extract_events.nim and whose results carry a complete, reproducible placement. The episode id list below IS the sample: it is not 'the most recent N rounds', which would name a different sample every day.
metric_of_record: corr(score, killRate) where score = results.scores[i] and killRate = 1000*kills/max(1,survivalTicks)
regenerate: List league league_b88a269b-0de7-4723-b1c7-06dab50fe61d rounds 2067-2110 via the public /v2/rounds?league_id=... listing (cursor-paged), then /v2/rounds/<round_id>/episodes?limit=1000 per round — all unauthenticated.
Download each completed episode's replay_url from the public softmax-public S3 bucket.
bin/extract_events <replay> --out <ep>.jsonl --results <ep>.results.json per replay; 'Replay game version does not match' buckets non-GV46 episodes rather than mixing them in.

Keep episodes whose summary finished=true, placementSlots is a permutation of the seats, and every seat has survivalTicks>0 and a nonempty name; compute corr(results.scores, 1000*kills/max(1,survivalTicks)) over all clean seat-episodes.

excluded_bucket.why: notExtracted: episodes whose replays could not be re-simulated at GV46 (21 'failed' status records plus 3 completed records with no replay_url). badPlacement: episodes whose results.placementSlots is not a complete permutation of the seats. They are bucketed, never mixed in.
